text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Exceptions to the principle are only possible when overriding public interests are at stake.", "gist": "Exceptions to the principle are limited to cases involving overriding public interests."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "«Cassis de Dijon principle»", "gist": "Cassis de Dijon principle"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Swiss manufacturers", "gist": "Swiss manufacturers"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Swiss manufacturers, who produce exclusively for the Swiss market, can also place products manufactured according to the regulations of EU or EU/EEA member state on the Swiss market (measures aimed at avoiding discrimination of domestic manufacturers).", "gist": "Swiss manufacturers can sell EU/EEA-compliant products in Switzerland to prevent domestic discrimination."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "foodstuffs", "gist": "Foodstuffs"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The application of the «Cassis de Dijon principle» for foodstuffs is subject to specific provisions (authorisation process).", "gist": "Foodstuffs are subject to specific provisions and an authorisation process under the Cassis de Dijon principle."}]}
